messages:
maya: Heads up — pen test intake: external red team coming Mon Apr 13 (two day window). Need final scope, RBAC freeze, KMS ephemeral access, and audit export plan. Who can own triage, packaging, and retest coordination?
liam: I can own triage + vuln prioritization. Re: KMS, we should use ephemeral grants via kms-proxy; don't hand out static keys. @jordan (sec-oncall) can you confirm proxy availability?
jordan (sec-oncall): kms-proxy OK. We'll create timeboxed grant for assessor role, expire at window end. Need list of target resources and cred holders. Also export path for audit logs?
sophia: For audit/logs: we'll export to s3://pt-audit-exports with 90d retention for now, and stream to log-archive. Need to ensure CloudTrail/immutability enabled and object lock on the bucket. I'll set up retention policy.
maya: Acceptance criteria for retest: fixes deployed to staging + log proof, vuln ticket closed with PR and risk signoff, and a snapshot of observability traces. Recommend retest window 7–10 days after remediation complete.
liam: Agree. I will create tracking board and link tickets. Q: can we get presigned evidence upload links for assessors?
sophia: Yes — will generate presigned S3 URLs and short-lived role for uploads. Command snippet:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/assessor-123.tgz --expires-in 3600
```
jordan (sec-oncall): Also add check for RBAC diffs — no permanent admin grants. We want reviewers to run:
```bash
# check recent policy changes
gcloud iam roles list --filter="title:Redwood*" --limit=50
```
maya: Can eng-platform run a quick dry-run to simulate exploit paths on staging? @deploy-bot schedule a canary deploy Friday.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for Fri 12:30 UTC to staging (ticket #PT-889).
liam: I'll own the retest liaison. Scheduling note: we need at least one oncall SRE + product security in the retest window.
sophia: I'll prep the evidence bundle checklist (logs, audit export, KMS grant ARN, PR links).
maya: OK — owners: liam (triage + retest liaison), sophia (audit & evidence), jordan (KMS & RBAC). I'll post the timeline doc and ticket board. :thumbsup:
liam: Moving to PT tracker now. ping me if you need access.
jordan (sec-oncall): leaving note — rotate the test key after window. No exceptions.
maya: thanks — we'll reconvene Wed to confirm scope lock.
